description: This file defines the interface for the OpenCDMSystem class, which provides methods for managing DRM systems, sessions, and related cryptographic data. It includes virtual functions for retrieving key system information, creating sessions, and managing DRM stores.
external_methods: OpenCDMSession *createSession(const LicenseType, OpenCDMSessionCallbacks *, void *, const std::string &, const std::vector<uint8_t> &)

classes.name: OpenCDMSystem
classes.description: An abstract class providing an interface for DRM system management, including session creation and store management.

methods.name: keySystem
methods.description: Returns the key system identifier string.

methods.name: metadata
methods.description: Returns metadata associated with the DRM system.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Creates a new DRM session with specified parameters.

methods.name: getLdlSessionsLimit
methods.description: Retrieves the limit on the number of LDL sessions.

methods.name: getKeyStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves the hash of the key store.

methods.name: getDrmStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves the hash of the DRM store.
